(a) There must be a means readily available to allow the UAV crew to rapidly shut off, in flight, the fuel to each engine individually.
(b) In addition, there must be means to
  (1) Prevent inadvertent operation of each shut-off valve; and
  (2) Allow appropriate UAV crew to reopen each valve rapidly after it has been closed.
(c) Where fitted, fuel tank selector must
  (1) Require a separate and distinct action to place the selector in the “OFF” position; and
  (2) Have the tank selector designed to operate so that it is impossible for the selector to pass through the “OFF” position when changing from one tank to another.
